title: Tiko the Tiny Satellite and the Sleepy Planet Song
description: A tiny pearl-white satellite hums a gentle bedtime song for peach planet Boba and mint-green planet Momo, then settles to sleep beside a quiet lavender world.

Tiko.role: Main character; a tiny toy-like satellite
Tiko.color: Pearl-white rounded body with a pale sky-blue front panel, powder-blue solar wings, and a short golden antenna with a tiny glowing bead
Tiko.bodyShape: Small rounded-square satellite with soft beveled edges and two short rectangular solar wings; no arms, hands, legs, wheels, or clothing
Tiko.face: Two small black oval eyes and a tiny curved smile on the central front panel, with soft peach cheek dots; never faces on the solar wings
Tiko.accessories: One short golden antenna topped with a tiny round glowing bead

Boba.role: Supporting character; a peach planet who first appears on page 5
Boba.color: Round peach planet with a subtle coral blush gradient and rosy cheeks
Boba.bodyShape: Small perfectly round planet with no limbs, accessories, rings, or surface markings
Boba.face: Two small dark-brown oval eyes and a tiny gentle smile that grow sleepy and close on page 11

Momo.role: Supporting character; a mint-green planet who first appears on page 8
Momo.color: Round mint-green planet with faint pink cheeks and a delicate pale-yellow ring
Momo.bodyShape: Small perfectly round planet with one thin pale-yellow ring tilted diagonally around her middle; no limbs or extra rings
Momo.face: Small dark eyes and a tiny curved smile that close on page 11
Momo.accessories: One pale-yellow ring that stays attached and diagonally oriented

settingBible.Miniature Solar System: A peaceful imaginary miniature solar system anchored by a large faceless lavender planet, with a faintly luminous curved orbital path, soft blue-violet cosmic haze, and gentle golden stars
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded space toys, periwinkle evening fading to velvet navy night, one scene per page, and no readable text or musical symbols on story pages

continuityRules: Tiko keeps pearl-white body, powder-blue solar wings, golden antenna, and front-panel face only.
Boba stays a ringless peach planet and first appears on page 5.
Momo stays a mint-green planet with one pale-yellow diagonal ring and first appears on page 8.
Boba and Momo are absent before their introduction pages.
Pages 11–15 keep Boba and Momo asleep; Tiko is fully asleep on page 15.
No rescue, danger, rockets, Earth landscapes, lettering, logos, or musical note symbols.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or readable words on story-page artwork.

pages.text: Far above the clouds, a tiny satellite named Tiko floated through the quiet, sparkling evening sky.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiny pearl-white satellite Tiko floats alone beside a gentle lavender planet among soft stars.
pages.continuityNotes: Tiko present; pearl-white body, powder-blue solar wings, golden antenna. Boba and Momo absent.

pages.text: Every evening, Tiko watched the planets settle down as the stars began to twinkle.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiko hovers peacefully near the lavender planet with distant pastel planets along a curved orbital path.
pages.continuityNotes: Tiko present; pearl-white body, powder-blue solar wings, golden antenna. Boba and Momo absent.

pages.text: Tonight, Tiko had a special idea. He would make a bedtime song for the whole little sky.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiko looks delighted with his small golden antenna glowing softly against the starry sky.
pages.timeOfDay: soft periwinkle evening with golden stars
pages.continuityNotes: Tiko present; pearl-white body, powder-blue solar wings, golden antenna. Boba and Momo absent.

pages.text: He hummed his first gentle note for the little stars to glow slow.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiko floats beside a cluster of tiny golden stars beginning to shimmer gently.
pages.continuityNotes: Tiko present; pearl-white body, powder-blue solar wings, golden antenna. Boba and Momo absent.

pages.text: A round peach-colored planet named Boba heard the song and gave a happy, sleepy smile.
pages.illustrationScene: Peach planet Boba first appears beside Tiko with rosy cheeks and a happy sleepy smile.
pages.continuityNotes: Tiko present; pearl-white body, powder-blue solar wings, golden antenna. Boba present; Momo absent.

pages.text: That sounds lovely, whispered Boba, but could you sing a little more.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiko faces Boba with tiny glowing musical swirls between them and no written notes.
pages.continuityNotes: Tiko present; pearl-white body, powder-blue solar wings, golden antenna. Boba present; Momo absent.

pages.text: Tiko hummed a softer tune as the planets glided round with cozy stars on every side.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiko drifts along a glowing orbital curve as Boba watches with the lavender planet behind them.
pages.continuityNotes: Tiko present; pearl-white body, powder-blue solar wings, golden antenna. Boba present; Momo absent.

pages.text: Soon, a little mint-green planet named Momo rolled gently into view.
pages.illustrationScene: Mint-green planet Momo first rolls into view with a thin pale-yellow ring and a drowsy expression.
pages.continuityNotes: Tiko present; pearl-white body, powder-blue solar wings, golden antenna. Boba and Momo present.

pages.text: Your song feels like a warm blanket, Momo whispered, slowly blinking.
pages.illustrationScene: Momo floats peacefully near Tiko and Boba among delicate misty starlight.
pages.continuityNotes: Tiko present; pearl-white body, powder-blue solar wings, golden antenna. Boba and Momo present.

pages.text: Tiko made his smallest, sweetest hum so the little planets could drift together toward sleep.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiko centers between Boba and Momo with a faintly glowing antenna and soft golden sound ripples.
pages.continuityNotes: Tiko present; pearl-white body, powder-blue solar wings, golden antenna. Boba and Momo present.

pages.text: Boba closed both eyes, and Momo tucked into the quiet curve of her glowing ring.
pages.illustrationScene: Boba sleeps on the left and Momo sleeps on the right with closed eyes while Tiko hovers nearby.
pages.continuityNotes: Tiko present; pearl-white body, powder-blue solar wings, golden antenna. Boba and Momo present. Planets asleep with closed eyes.

pages.text: Even the smallest stars seemed to twinkle more slowly, listening to Tiko's sleepy song.
pages.illustrationScene: Wide celestial scene with tiny Tiko in the foreground and sleeping Boba and Momo farther back.
pages.continuityNotes: Tiko present; pearl-white body, powder-blue solar wings, golden antenna. Boba and Momo present. Planets asleep with closed eyes.

pages.text: Goodnight, Boba, Momo, and every little star, Tiko whispered.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiko drifts gently away from the sleeping planets along the orbital path with a faint antenna glow.
pages.continuityNotes: Tiko present; pearl-white body, powder-blue solar wings, golden antenna. Boba and Momo present. Planets asleep with closed eyes.

pages.text: Tiko found his favorite quiet spot beside the lavender planet and folded his little solar wings close.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiko settles in peaceful orbit beside the lavender planet with solar wings folded slightly inward.
pages.continuityNotes: Tiko present; pearl-white body, powder-blue solar wings, golden antenna. Boba and Momo present. Planets asleep with closed eyes. Tiko settling; eyes closed on page 15.

pages.text: And as the whole little sky rested, Tiko hummed one last tiny note, then drifted to sleep among the stars.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiko sleeps with closed eyes beside the lavender planet while Boba and Momo sleep far in the background.
pages.continuityNotes: Tiko present; pearl-white body, powder-blue solar wings, golden antenna. Boba and Momo present. Planets asleep with closed eyes. Tiko settling; eyes closed on page 15.
